methods_quotes.q: Temporal trends were evaluated by applying the Joinpoint Regression Program (version 4.7.0.0; National Cancer Institute) to the annual rates.
Annual percentage change was estimated for each trend segment and considered significantly different from zero for p-values <0.05.
Rates and 95% confidence intervals were calculated by using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute), accounting for sample weights and the complex survey design.
